title: The Sloth: Master of Nothing

scenes.narration: Deep in the rainforests of Central and South America lives an animal that has turned doing nothing into a fine art. Meet the sloth.

shots.prompt: wide shot of a lush rainforest canopy at golden sunrise, drifting mist, cinematic, no animals
a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, hanging upside down from a branch, slowly opening one sleepy eye, close up

scenes.narration: There are six species, split into two families: the two-toed and the three-toed. Both share one life philosophy: why rush?

shots.prompt: two cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws sitting side by side on a mossy branch, one shrugging
a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, lazily stretching one arm in the sunlight

scenes.narration: Everything about this creature is built to save energy. Its metabolism is one of the slowest of any mammal, so it burns very little fuel.

shots.prompt: a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, chewing a green leaf extremely slowly, funny relaxed face, close up
a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, lying on a branch looking relaxed and sleepy, soft light

scenes.narration: In the wild, sloths sleep around nine or ten hours a day. The rest of the time is spent eating leaves, very, very slowly.

shots.prompt: a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, curled up asleep in the fork of a tree, tiny bubbles, peaceful
a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, reaching slowly for a leaf with one claw, green jungle background

scenes.narration: That leafy diet is so low in energy that digesting a single meal can take a month or more. Imagine waiting that long for lunch.

shots.prompt: a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, sitting at a tiny wooden table with an empty plate looking hungry and patient, comedic
a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, looking at a big wall clock with a bored expression, comedic

scenes.narration: Its fur is a tiny ecosystem. Algae grows in it, tinting the coat green, which helps the sloth vanish into the leaves.

shots.prompt: extreme close up of fluffy brown sloth fur with green algae tint, tiny glints of light
a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws with a green tint, blending into green leaves, hide and seek

scenes.narration: Moths and beetles live in the fur too. Sloths are basically a hotel with a very slow check in.

shots.prompt: tiny moths fluttering around a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, jungle light
a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws wearing a tiny bellhop hat, funny, jungle hotel lobby made of leaves

scenes.narration: Because they live upside down, even their hair is different. It parts along the belly and flows toward the back, so rain simply runs off.

shots.prompt: a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, hanging upside down in a tropical rainstorm, rain droplets sliding off its fur
a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, shaking raindrops from its fur, close up, sparkling water

scenes.narration: Their necks are flexible too. A sloth can turn its head around about two hundred and seventy degrees, perfect for spotting trouble without moving anything else.

shots.prompt: a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, slowly turning its head far around to look behind, surprised funny expression
a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, glancing left and right suspiciously, comedic, tree branch

scenes.narration: And trouble is real. Harpy eagles and jaguars hunt sloths, but staying still and green turns out to be a surprisingly effective hiding strategy.

shots.prompt: giant harpy eagle gliding over the rainforest canopy, a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws frozen still on a branch below
a jaguar prowling past a tree while a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws hides motionless among leaves, tense but funny

scenes.narration: Once a week, the sloth does something incredibly risky. It climbs all the way down to the forest floor for a bathroom break.

shots.prompt: a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, slowly climbing down a tall tree trunk, determined face
a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, tiptoeing on the jungle floor nervously looking around, comedic

scenes.narration: The moths lay their eggs right there, which is why they keep such close company. The whole trip is a very big deal, and takes a very long time.

shots.prompt: small moths fluttering around a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws on the forest floor, magical light rays
a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, climbing slowly back up a tree, proud happy face

scenes.narration: Out of the trees sloths are clumsy, but in water they are surprisingly graceful swimmers, and can hold their breath far longer than humans can.

shots.prompt: a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, swimming across a calm jungle river, paddling its arms, happy
a cute chubby sloth with fluffy brown fur, cream colored face, dark eye patches, long curved claws, swimming underwater among bubbles and fish, peaceful, sunbeams

scenes.narration: So the next time you feel behind on life, remember the sloth. It has survived for millions of years by going slow, staying calm, and never skipping a nap.
